text: RESULTS: Vital_Signs: Temperature 98°F (36.7°C), Blood_Pressure 91/55 mmHg, Heart_Rate 207/min, Respiratory_Rate 50/min, Oxygen_Saturation 97% on room air. speaker: Doctor
text: The tachycardia and pallor strongly suggest significant anemia, which may be driving the apnea episodes. speaker: Doctor
text: Since the chief physician has confirmed Z-Syndrome and restricted further testing, I will rely on the clinical presentation of anemia-induced apnea in this one-month-old.
